messages.content: 從紐約到洛杉磯的最短駕駛里程是多少英里，再從洛杉磯到邁阿密，考慮到你必須從邁阿密返回紐約？

function.name: get_shortest_driving_distance
function.description: Calculate the shortest driving distance between two locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit.description: Preferred unit of distance (optional, default is kilometers).

message.reasoning: The user asks: "從紐約到洛杉磯的最短駕駛里程是多少英里，再從洛杉磯到邁阿密，考慮到你必須從邁阿密返回紐約？" They want the shortest driving distance from New York to Los Angeles in miles, then from Los Angeles to Miami, considering you must return from Miami to New York. So they want total distance? They might want each leg separately and then total. The user didn't specify a unit but asked for miles. So we need to call get_shortest_driving_distance twice: once for NY to LA, once for LA to Miami. Then compute total distance including return from Miami to NY. But we don't have a function for return from Miami to NY. We can call get_shortest_driving_distance for Miami to NY. Then sum all three distances. The user didn't ask for the return distance explicitly, but they said "considering you must return from Miami to New York". So we should include that leg. So we need to call get_shortest_driving_distance for NY->LA, LA->Miami, Miami->NY. Then sum. The function get_shortest_driving_distance expects origin, destination, unit optional. We'll set unit to "miles". We'll call it thrice. Then sum. We'll produce a response with each leg distance and total. We'll use the function calls.
